name: RepoLadder
what: The RepoLadder engine and Claude Code plugin: analyzer, diagram viewer, /map plugin, CLI and npm package

deploys.what: publishes the npm package when a v* tag is pushed on main; needs environment approval

checks.name: leakguard
checks.note: internal terms, home-directory paths and secret shapes; this repo is public

tiers.name: unit
tiers.what: npm test: node:test over test/*.test.ts with fixtures

tools.name: node
tools.fix: install Node 22 or newer from nodejs.org or with nvm

tools.name: gh
tools.what: GitHub CLI for PRs and issues

policy: Never edit, rebuild or commit plugin/dist: the bot rebuilds it after releases, and a PR that touches it fails the no-dist check. After `npm run build`, run `git checkout -- plugin/dist`.
Never merge into main or push a v* tag: releases are a develop to main merge-commit PR, and the tag publishes to npm.
Issue and PR text must pass `npm run leakguard -- --text`: no internal notes, local paths or ticket jargon.

routing.summary: RepoLadder engine and Claude Code plugin: analyzer, diagram viewer, /map plugin, CLI, npm package, docs and CI
owns: repo analysis: facts, imports, endpoints, stores
diagram viewer, layout and the detail dial
plugin CI, install check and release workflows
routing.note: public repo: write issues, plans and PR text as if public, with no internal notes. Launch operations, accounts, secrets, infra, legal, strategy and monetization go to the site tracker.
